title: Three Springs and One Short Flag
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（人与社会·历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（人与社会·历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：liberation　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 liberation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1945 the soldier ① won the liberation that no villager in the valley would have recorded, and he said the winning was the whole of the spring. The ② liberation, meaning the freedom itself and not the flag, ran three springs and stayed unrecorded in the book; liberation, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ moment of liberation in that valley had the same short flag beside it, and the ④ liberation at the far bridge, meaning the order they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Liberation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the soldier said the recording is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the liberation was the whole of the matter, meaning the promise and not the freedom. The ⑥ liberation, meaning the promise and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; liberation, he said, is either something you win or the only word that means both freedom and a promise. He said the promise is the part they remember.

By 1950 the ⑦ liberation had become a line in a dispatch, and the dispatch had become an argument about the short flag. The ⑧ liberation of the whole thing, the soldier wrote in August, was one valley and three springs of recording; liberation, he said, is either the order at the far bridge or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ liberation I remember is the liberation recorded in the dispatch, which closed in 1952 and is still recorded as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Liberation, my mother said in 1954, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all liberation, she said, is a promise that has agreed to look like freedom. She said the promise was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 解放；解脱（指山谷里每一刻旁边的那一刻）
B. n. 解放；解脱（指那次解放本身，与旗子相对）
C. 固定搭配：win the liberation 赢得这次解放
D. n. 解放；解脱（指留给孩子们守着的那道命令那一次）
E. n. 战事之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的解放之事）
F. n. 解放；解脱（指战报里写到、被记载的的那一次）
G. n. 许诺、新生（指一件事里人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 新生（抽象总称，指人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: won the liberation that no villager in the valley would have recorded
The liberation, meaning the freedom itself and not the flag
Every moment of liberation in that valley
the liberation at the far bridge
the liberation was the whole of the matter
the liberation had become a line in a dispatch
The liberation of the whole thing

answers.why: win the liberation 意为“赢得这次解放”，1945 年那位战士把山谷里没有一位村民肯记载的一次解放做了一遍。
liberation 意为“解放；解脱”，指那次解放本身而不是旗子，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被记载。
liberation 意为“解放；解脱”，指山谷里每一刻旁边的那一刻，每一刻旁边都有同一面窄窄的旗子。
liberation 意为“解放；解脱”，指最远那座桥头留给孩子们守着的那道命令那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
liberation 意为“许诺、新生”，指一件事里人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份许诺就是那件事的全部。
liberation 意为“新生”，指人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次解放，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
liberation 意为“解放；解脱”，指战报里写到、被记载的的那一次，到 1950 年这一次成了战报里的一行。
liberation 意为“战事之事”，战士八月写道，整件事的解放之事是一处山谷和三个春天的记载。
liberation 意为“解放；解脱”，我记得的是战报里记载过的那一次，1952 年迎来了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一次。
liberation 为抽象总称，母亲 1954 年说，解放是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的解放。

items: 1945 年那位战士赢得了山谷里没有一位村民肯记载的一次解放，他说这一遍才是那个春天的全部。（win the liberation）
那次解放，指的是那次解放本身而不是旗子，经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被记载。（liberation）
那处山谷里每一刻解放旁边都有同一面窄窄的旗子。（liberation）
